 WFTV’s Chief Meteorologist Tom Terry recalls warning viewers during 2006 tornado.
 By James Tutten, WFTV.com November 08, 2026 at 11:12 am EST Enter Fullscreen Expand Channel 9’s Tom Terry remembers 2006 Election Day tornado By James Tutten, WFTV.com November 08, 2026 at 11:12 am EST SEMINOLE COUNTY, Fla. — Channel 9 is looking back at 30 years of Central Florida’s chief meteorologist, Tom Terry.
 20 years ago on Sunday, two major stories hit on the same day, an election and a major tornado in Seminole County.
 Terry was live on Channel 9 on Nov. 8 2006, telling people to hunker down, moments before the tornado touched down.
 The Election Day tornado would end up traveling more than a mile and damaging 55 buildings.
